name: HowardHinnant/date
listed_description: Third-party calendar and time zone library for pre-C++20 compilers; the foundation of the C++20 chrono additions.
guessed_baseline: C <ctime> (mktime, strftime, strptime) and std::chrono from standard libraries
found_in: book: Modern C++ Programming Cookbook, 3rd ed. (2024), ch. 6, Working with calendars (There's more)

name: Bulk read() of whole binary file into pre-sized buffer
listed_description: Open the file in binary mode, find its size, allocate a buffer once, then fill it with one stream read() call instead of iterator-based copying.
claim_text: The read() method is the fastest one compared with the istreambuf_iterator alternatives; the book leaves measuring as an exercise.
book_benchmark: No measurement in the book; bare assertion against vector construction or assign or copy with std::istreambuf_iterator and back_inserter.
guessed_baseline: std::istreambuf_iterator based file slurp into std::vector or std::string
found_in: book: Modern C++ Programming Cookbook, 3rd ed. (2024), ch. 7, Reading and writing raw data from/to binary files (There's more)
